meta.prompt: Show me a recipe card for a weeknight lemon chicken traybake: 45 minutes, Easy, serves 4 to start, with a servings control from 2 to 8 that scales the ingredient amounts. Ingredients for 4: chicken thighs 800 g, baby potatoes 600 g, lemons 2, olive oil 4 tbsp, garlic cloves 4, dried oregano 2 tsp. The ingredients as a checklist I can tick off (ticks stay when I change the servings), the four steps (Heat the oven to 220C; Toss everything in the oil, lemon and oregano; Roast 35 minutes, turning once; Rest 5 minutes and serve) and a Start cooking button.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Lemon chicken traybake" "Weeknight dinner · 45 min · Easy" icon:"restaurant_rounded" status:"Easy" w:390
  state servings=4
  state done=[]
  Row between
    Text.strong "Serves {servings}"
    Counter "Servings" =servings min:2 max:8 step:1
  Checklist "Ingredients" =done items:["Chicken thighs, {round(800*servings/4,0)} g","Baby potatoes, {round(600*servings/4,0)} g","Lemons, {ceil(2*servings/4)}","Olive oil, {round(4*servings/4,0)} tbsp","Garlic cloves, {round(4*servings/4,0)}","Dried oregano, {round(2*servings/4,1)} tsp"]
  SectionLabel "Method" "4 steps"
  Column gap:6
    Row gap:8
      Text.strong "1."
      Paragraph "Heat the oven to 220C."
    Row gap:8
      Text.strong "2."
      Paragraph "Toss everything in the oil, lemon and oregano."
    Row gap:8
      Text.strong "3."
      Paragraph "Roast 35 minutes, turning once."
    Row gap:8
      Text.strong "4."
      Paragraph "Rest 5 minutes and serve."
  ActionButton "Start cooking" primary icon:"play_arrow_rounded" enabled:true -> emit start_cooking
